title: Sampathige Saval
desc: Siddappa, a cruel landlord, refuses to pay the funeral expenses of his servant after his accidental death. Angered by the betrayal, the worker's son, Veerabhadra, grows up to resent Siddappa.

title: Namma Preethiya Ramu
desc: Ramu, a singer with visual impairment, tries to earn a living for his family through his meagre income. However, his life changes when an evil man with hidden motives promises him his eyesight.

title: Yamanige Ganda
desc: An error grants Naresh eternal life, prompting him to assist deities in numerous missions. However, when he develops feelings for Lord Yama's daughter, he incurs the wrath of the death god.

title: Bahubali: The Beginning
desc: A tribal-raised boy learns he is Mahishmati royalty, discovers his father's bravery, and aims to overthrow the current king.
